tools.name: list_my_rosters
tools.description: Lists the rosters saved to the signed-in Praetorium account. Requires mcp:read.

tools.name: get_my_roster
tools.description: Returns the saved choices for one roster owned by the signed-in player. Requires mcp:read.

tools.name: list_my_battles
tools.description: Lists up to 25 battles with a cursor for the next page. Requires mcp:read.

tools.name: get_my_battle
tools.description: Returns the current seated view of a battle for the signed-in player. Requires mcp:read.

tools.name: save_roster
tools.description: Saves a complete roster. Pass its id to edit an owned roster; omit id to create one. Requires mcp:write.

tools.name: set_roster_visibility
tools.description: Changes the visibility of an owned roster. Requires mcp:write.

tools.name: create_battle
tools.description: Creates a battle with named player seats, using the same rules as the site. Requires mcp:write.

tools.name: submit_battle_action
tools.description: Appends a legal battle command only when expectedSeq matches the current log. Requires mcp:write.

tools.name: search_reference
tools.description: Searches the verified mission, rules, detachment, and datasheet text used by Praetorium. Returns bounded excerpts with canonical URLs, source revisions, and attribution.

tools.name: get_reference
tools.description: Reads the complete bounded document returned by search_reference, with its source location, revisions, and attribution.

tools.name: get_reference_record
tools.description: Returns the source-faithful structured record behind a search result, including mission cards, deployments, terrain geometry, detachments, and datasheets.

tools.name: list_factions
tools.description: Lists the factions that can be used to narrow reference searches.

tools.name: list_reference
tools.description: Discovers available factions, mission packs, rule documents, reference kinds, and active source revisions.

tools.name: list_units
tools.description: Returns every pickable unit in one bounded response with unit-size costs, composition, attachment relationships, roster limits, roles, keywords, and links. Include a detachment to receive its complete rules, enhancements, upgrades, and stratagems without opening every unit page.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_reference · Private data: get_reference, get_reference_record, list_reference · Public sink: submit_battle_action.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_reference · Private data: get_reference, get_reference_record, list_reference · Public sink: submit_battle_action

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
